model.name: Task 22.2: Drawer pan/zoom — full mouse parity (touch-first)
model.description: The drawer pan/zoom is touch-first (touch is the primary design surface) but MUST work identically with a mouse: mouse-drag pans (mirrors 1-finger pan), scroll-wheel zooms toward the pointer (mirrors pinch-zoom), and double-click resets/toggles (mirrors double-tap). Mouse mirrors the touch behaviour exactly.
model.intention: Tron: "the drawer works well on touch and it shall be touch first, but it shall also work the same way with mouse."
model.context: Traceability browser detail drawer. Touch gestures were complete; mouse-drag/scroll-wheel/double-click parity was the gap (architect-measured: dblclick → double-tap toggle was the single missing path).
